samples: This program is a simple greeting application that prints a personalized hello message to the console. It reads the first command-line argument provided by the user and uses it as a name in the greeting; if no argument is given, it defaults to greeting "world". You can run it with or without a name parameter to see different greetings.

This program is a simple greeting application that prints a personalized hello message. It reads the first command-line argument provided by the user and uses it as a name in the greeting; if no argument is given, it defaults to greeting "world". When run, it outputs "Hello, [name]!" to the console.
